content: प्रवचनम् .²1 Speaking, declaration, announcement; प्रवचने मान्द्यम् <ls>Pt. 1. 190</ls>. .²2 Teaching, expounding. .²3 Exposition, explanation, interpretation; नायमात्मा प्रवचनेन लभ्यो न भेधया न बहुना श्रुतेन <ls>Kaṭh. 1. 2. 22</ls>; लब्ध्वा ज्ञानमनेकधा प्रवचनैर्मन्वादयः प्राणयन् <ls>Mv. 4. 25</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 1</ls>. .²4 Eloquence. .²5 A sacred treatise or writing; <ls>Ms. 3. 184</ls>. .²6 An expression, a term. .²7 A system of doctrines (in the form of a treatise). .²8 The fundamental doctrine of the Buddhists. .{@-नः@} One who exposes, propounds; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 87. 11</ls>.
